notes.title: Earn to Die 2 is now live!
notes.content:
Thanks again to everyone for their support during the Greenlight process. We are very excited that Earn to Die 2 is now live on Steam :)

We hope you enjoy. Now go smash those zombies!

notes.title: Earn to Die 2 launching next Thursday May 5!
notes.content:
We're very excited to announce that we now have an official launch date for Earn to Die 2 on Steam!

The game will be available in one week from today, on Thursday May 5.

Thanks to everyone who supported us on Greenlight. We look forward to launching Earn to Die 2 on Steam :)!
